rows.name: a0 (canonical footing)
rows.formula: a0 = s_DE/2 = (c/2) sqrt(G rho_Lambda), kappa = 1/2

rows.name: a0 (alt footing)
rows.formula: a0 = s_DE/2 with kappa = 0.6 (the certified alternative footing)

rows.name: s = 2 a0 (canonical)
rows.formula: s = 2 a0 = c sqrt(G rho_Lambda) (canonical); alt footing 2 x 1.1279e-10

rows.name: rho_Lambda (canonical)
rows.formula: rho_Lambda = 4 a0^2/(G c^2)

rows.name: Lambda_geom (canonical footing)
rows.formula: Lambda_geom = 32 pi a0^2/c^4 = 8 pi G rho_Lambda/c^2

rows.name: Z = sqrt(8 pi Omega_L / 3)
rows.formula: Z = sqrt(8 pi Omega_Lambda/3), the horizon-virial / framework-scale ratio

rows.name: r_M (MW baryons 6.5e10 Msun)
rows.formula: r_M = sqrt(G Mb / a0)
rows.lane: G003 V6 chain; G031 PART 4 (r_M = sqrt(G Mb/a0))

rows.name: sigma_virial (MW baryons 6.5e10 Msun)
rows.formula: sigma^2 = G Mb/(2 r_M) = (1/2) sqrt(G Mb a0); sigma in km/s

rows.name: v_flat (MW baryons 6.5e10 Msun)
rows.formula: v_flat = (G Mb a0)^{1/4} (the deep-MOND BTFR amplitude)

rows.name: rho_ph(R0 = 8.2 kpc), MW
rows.formula: rho_ph(R0) = sqrt(G Mb a0)/(4 pi G R0^2), Mb = 6.5e10 Msun, R0 = 8.2 kpc (Msun/pc^3)

rows.name: z_c layer half-width
rows.formula: z_c = a0/(16 pi G rho_b), rho_b = 0.095 Msun/pc^3

rows.name: z* = 4 z_c (branch crossover)
rows.formula: z* = 4 z_c exactly (the sqrt-vertical to Newtonian crossover)

rows.name: peak two-sided phantom column
rows.formula: col_ph = a0/(8 pi G) in Msun/pc^2 (each footing's own lane print)
rows.lane: G024_slab_limit V2 (canonical col = 26.72 = a0/(8 pi G) exactly; alt print 32.19)

rows.name: nu_layer
rows.formula: nu_layer = (baryon + phantom column)/baryon column = 2 exactly
rows.lane: G024_slab_limit V2 (column identity, sympy-exact; Lean G024_slab.lean)

rows.name: gamma_v (22-30 kAU binned mean, G018 population; registered 1.047)
rows.formula: population mean of sqrt(1/[1-(1+Y_i+Y_e)^-2]) over G018's 22-30 kAU bin; Y_i = 2 g_N/s_DE, Y_e = 2 g_ext/s_DE
rows.lane: G018 PART B bin 22-30 kAU mean 1.0467 (exact seed 20260914); G026 E6; L240 PART F additive law

rows.name: EFE cap a_break
rows.formula: a_break = sqrt(G M_pair/g_ext), M_pair = 2 Msun, g_ext = (233 km/s)^2/8.2 kpc
rows.lane: G014 PART A (the break semimajor axis, registered 7.4 kAU)

rows.name: Omega_Lambda from a0 (canonical)
rows.formula: Omega_L = Lambda^4/rho_crit = 4 a0^2/(G rho_crit c^2) (canonical, the Z-theorem)

rows.name: Omega_Lambda from a0 (alt footing; G052's registered FAIL row)
rows.formula: same formula, alt footing: does NOT land on Planck (G052's recorded FAIL, ratio 1.4537)
rows.lane: G052 Va (the alt-footing mismatch is itself a registered finding)

rows.name: growth raise, D(0)/D_LCDM (L180 kernel)
rows.formula: G_eff/G = nu(cH/a0), nu(x) = 1/(1-e^{-sqrt(x)}); linear growth ODE in ln a
rows.lane: L180 E2 (registered sigma8 ratios 1.0109 canonical / 1.0154 alt)

rows.name: RAR total scatter, deep-regime pooled rms
rows.formula: pooled per-point rms of delta = log10(g_obs/g_th) in the deep regime (r/r_M > 2)
rows.lane: G002 V11 (0.150 canonical, 155 curves); G036 V1 (0.174 deep, SPARC ingest); G049 comparator

rows.name: RAR scatter floor with per-galaxy M/L freedom
rows.formula: median per-galaxy rms with stellar M/L freed in [0.2, 1.2]
rows.lane: G013 V1 (0.0639 median); G040 V3 (0.0939 M/L-adjusted median over 171 galaxies; alt 0.0984)

rows.name: Within-galaxy white-noise floor
rows.formula: within-galaxy pooled rms after per-galaxy offset (and line) removed
rows.lane: G036 V4a (0.0447 within-galaxy); G044 V1E (0.0524/0.0538); registered band 0.045-0.052

rows.name: Population-mean deep sag
rows.formula: mean per-galaxy deep-regime slope d(delta)/d log10(r/r_M), one sign, 4-5 sigma
rows.lane: G036 V4d (-0.1310 canonical / -0.1380 alt); G049 V0 anchor; registered -0.13
